invariants.why: sprite hit-testing and the 2D diagonal walk are retired with the PixiJS editor; the 3D editor picks with the raycaster and the face normal decides the adjacent cell

invariants.must_contain: Clicking the face of a cube places in the adjacent cell
invariants.why: the Minecraft-style placement contract: face normal maps to the adjacent cell, ground plane falls to z=0

invariants.must_contain: the first hit is the nearest surface
invariants.why: intersections are sorted by distance; the first hit is the cell the camera actually sees
the ground plane guarantees a fallback cell, so a tool always has somewhere to land a piece
height is maxZ+1; a tool that would leave a floating gap produces an invalid column, not a hole
substituting a nearby tile hides a tileset that was paid for and came back incomplete

invariants.must_contain: The bit order is a guess
invariants.why: AB-371 is an open assumption; presenting it as settled launders a guess into a fact

invariants.must_contain: moving a block changes its id
invariants.why: the instance id is derived from the position, so a block is the contents of a cell and not an entity that walks; treating it as stable breaks any consumer that tracks blocks across edits
what is missing must not be filled with an invented convention
authoring format and export format are deliberately different; collapsing them either bloats the project file or forces the physics consumer to decode RLE
